character_facts: Aghnar is capable of fighting an armed robot in a low-gravity or weightless environment.
Aghnar is trusted by at least one observer, who explicitly says they have faith in him.
The white-haired woman is monitoring the duel closely and is surprised by Aghnar's endurance or survival time.
characters_present: A large combat robot or training robot
A white-haired woman observing the trial
A second observer on the platform
continuity_links: This page continues an ongoing trial or rite centered on Aghnar's worthiness to become a Metabaron.
The page reinforces an earlier concern about Aghnar's weightlessness while showing that the test is still underway.
dialogue_meaning: The observers set the condition for Aghnar's acceptance: success depends on activating the robot's self-destruct system.
Aghnar's lack of weight is explicitly framed as a possible disqualifying trait, but the speaker is willing to overlook it if he passes this test.
The observers express confidence in Aghnar before unleashing the robot.
A watching woman is astonished that the duel has lasted ten minutes.
locations: An industrial or laboratory-like interior chamber
An elevated observation platform overlooking the chamber
lore_facts: There is a formal or semi-formal test for becoming a future Metabaron.
Aghnar is being judged specifically in relation to becoming a future Metabaron.
Aghnar's weightlessness is treated as a noteworthy issue in that judgment.
The trial involves a lethal or dangerous robot with a self-destruct mechanism that can apparently be manually activated by the candidate.
plot_events: Observers declare that if Aghnar can trigger the robot's self-destruct mechanism, he will be accepted as a future Metabaron despite his weightlessness.
Someone orders the robot killer to be activated.
The combat robot powers on and deploys long blade weapons.
Aghnar engages the robot in close combat inside the chamber.
The fight continues for ten minutes without Aghnar being defeated, surprising a watching woman.
uncertainties: Some dialogue is small and partially hard to read; wording may not be exact.
The identity of the first speaker on the observation platform is unclear from this page alone.
It is not fully certain whether the white-haired woman in the last panel is one of the two observers shown at the start.
The page image is labeled p26 in metadata, but the printed page number visible in the image appears to be 27.
visual_summary: Inside a metallic industrial chamber, two onlookers watch from a platform and discuss Aghnar's trial. Close-up panels show a rounded combat robot powering up, extending blade-like weapons, and moving into attack mode. Aghnar, wearing a suit and helmet, confronts the machine in midair or low gravity, dodging and countering as the robot slashes the floor and lunges repeatedly. In the final panel, a white-haired woman reacts in surprise that ten minutes have already passed.
